name: Bai Ke
bio: Bai Ke (白客), a new-generation actor, is one of the members of CUCN201, a group that has created a popular click mythology due to Funny Comic Day and Chinese dubbing. He is good at creating and performing individual lines and creating countless popular spoken words. After moving from behind the scenes to the front of the stage, he has appeared in many online film and television works, and he has won industry recognition and fans' love for his handsome appearance and natural acting skills. His main works include the net drama Unexpectedly and the micro-movie Old Magician.
